text: From Greg Wischer at the United States Department of the Interior:“Another fountain has been fixed, beautified, and turned on — The Rawlins Park fountain! This fountain was defunct for nearly a decade, and the fountain’s plumbing, electrical, mechanical systems all needed repairs. Like other parks with fountains, the park with this fountain was also beautified. The park features a magnolia-lined flagstone plaza with an octagonal bubbling fountain flanked by two 116-foot-long reflecting pools. The bronze statue of Union General John Aaron Rawlins—who was the closest advisor to Ulysses S. Grant during the Civil War and later served as Secretary of War under President Grant—was cleaned and waxed, too. The statue was cast from captured Confederate cannons and installed in 1874.”
zh: 美国内政部的格雷格·威舍尔 (Greg Wischer) 表示：“另一个喷泉已经修复、美化并启用——罗林斯公园喷泉！这个喷泉已经废弃了近十年，喷泉的管道、电气、机械系统都需要维修。像其他有喷泉的公园一样，有这个喷泉的公园也被美化了。公园有一个铺着木兰的石板广场，广场上有一个八角形的冒泡喷泉，两侧有两个喷泉116 英尺长的倒影池。联邦将军约翰·亚伦·罗林斯 (John Aaron Rawlins) 的青铜雕像——他是内战期间尤利西斯·S·格兰特 (Ulysses S. Grant) 最亲密的顾问，后来担任格兰特总统的战争部长——也用缴获的南方联盟大炮铸造而成，并于 1874 年安装。

text: From Greg Wischer at the United States Department of the Interior:“Here is another fountain update —Another one was just turned on. The Freedom Plaza fountain, which is located just southeast of the White House Ballroom, is not only fixed but also significantly improved, just like the President’s other beautification projects across D.C. The fountain was experiencing structural deterioration, so virtually every component of the fountain was replaced and upgraded — The pumps, piping, wiring, lighting, vault, masonry, and mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems.”
zh: 来自美国内政部的格雷格·威舍尔 (Greg Wischer)：“这是另一个喷泉更新 - 另一个刚刚打开。位于白宫宴会厅东南部的自由广场喷泉不仅得到了修复，而且得到了显着改进，就像总统在华盛顿特区的其他美化项目一样。喷泉正在经历结构恶化，因此几乎喷泉的每个组件都被更换和升级 - 泵、管道、电线、照明、拱顶、砖石以及机械、电气和管道系统”。
